In questo caso non sussiste un problema di dipendenza spaziale,
perché non c'è un confronto within-sample perciò questo approccio dovrebbe andare bene:
sono come i DEG normali ma prendendo solo la parte trattata dei campioni

#objects
```{r}
bin16_list_ann <- readRDS("~/bin16_list_ann.rds")
treat_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in%
                                   c("c26murf1_b2", "c26murf1_b3", "c26murf1_b5", "c26murf1_b9",
                                     "c26foxO_b1","c26foxO_b4","c26foxO_b6","c26foxO_b9",
                                     "c26SMAD23_b2","c26SMAD23_b4","c26SMAD23_b5","c26SMAD23_b9")]

treat_list$c26murf1_b2$to_discard <- NULL
treat_list$c26SMAD23_b2$to_discard <- NULL
treat_list$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(treat_list$c26murf1_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)
treat_list$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment <- ifelse(treat_list$c26SMAD23_b2$in_treatment == TRUE, 1, 0)

#only keeping treated fibers
treat_list <- lapply(treat_list, function(spe){
  treated <- spe$in_treatment == "1"
  spe <- spe[,treated]
})

c26_list <- bin16_list_ann[names(bin16_list_ann) %in% c("c26_b2","c26_b4","c26_b6")]

new_list <- c(treat_list,c26_list)

myonuclei_types <- c("Myonuclei_IIb", "Myonuclei_IIx",
                     "Myonuclei_IIx_IIa", "Myonuclei_IIx_IIb",
                     "Myonuclei_MTJ", "Myonuclei_NMJ", "Myonuclei_Trim63")

contrast_list <- list(
  "FOXO_vs_C26"   = c("tissue_typec26foxO - tissue_typec26"),
  "MURF1_vs_C26"  = c("tissue_typec26murf1 - tissue_typec26"),
  "SMAD23_vs_C26" = c("tissue_typec26SMAD23 - tissue_typec26")
)

```

#Creating a combined_spe object
```{r}

# Add sample identifiers
for (nm in names(new_list)) {
  spe <- new_list[[nm]]
  colData(spe)$sample_id <- rep(nm, ncol(spe))
  new_list[[nm]] <- spe
}
  
combined_spe <- do.call(cbind, new_list)
filtered_spe <- combined_spe[, combined_spe$new_cell_type %in% myonuclei_types]
  
pb <- aggregateAcrossCells(filtered_spe, use.assay.type = "counts", id = filtered_spe$sample_id)

colnames(pb) <- paste(pb$tissue_id, pb$sample_id, sep = "_")

pb$tissue_type <- droplevels(pb$tissue_type)

```

#DEGs between conditions
```{r}
y <- DGEList(counts(pb), samples = colData(pb))
keep <- filterByExpr(y, group = y$samples$tissue_type)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + tissue_type, data = y$samples)
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmFit(y, design)

summary_list <- list()

for (contrast_name in names(contrast_list)){
  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = contrast_list[[contrast_name]],
    levels = design
  )

  lrt <- glmLRT(fit, contrast = contrast)
  top <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf)$table
  top$SYMBOL <- rownames(top)
  top$significant <- top$FDR < 0.05
  sig <- top[top$significant, ]
  sig_up <- sig[sig$logFC >= 0, ]
  sig_down <- sig[sig$logFC < 0, ]
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "Tutti_geni")
  writeData(wb, "Tutti_geni", top, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Significativi")
  writeData(wb, "Significativi", sig, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Upregolati")
  writeData(wb, "Upregolati", sig_up, rowNames = TRUE)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Downregolati")
  writeData(wb, "Downregolati", sig_down, rowNames = TRUE)
  file_name <- paste0("DEG_", contrast_name, ".xlsx")
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_name, overwrite = TRUE)
  gene_summary <- data.frame(
    contrast = contrast_name,
    genes_tested = nrow(top),
    genes_significant = nrow(sig),
    upregulated = nrow(sig_up),
    downregulated = nrow(sig_down)
  )
  summary_list[[contrast_name]] <- gene_summary
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)
print(summary_df)
```
